name: M3_PPS100MI_LstStgPrice
description: List staggered purchase prices for a specific purchase agreement line, identified by supplier and agreement number. Staggered prices form a price ladder where different prices apply from different purchased quantities. Use this operation to review the complete staggered price structure currently valid for an agreement line.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Supplier number identifying the supplier whose staggered prices are listed.

inputParameters.name: AGNB
inputParameters.description: Agreement number identifying the purchase agreement whose staggered prices are listed.

inputParameters.name: GRPI
inputParameters.description: Group identity that defines the key combination used to locate the agreement line whose staggered prices are listed.

inputParameters.name: OBV1
inputParameters.description: Primary start value in the group identity that, together with the group identity, identifies the agreement line whose staggered prices are listed.

inputParameters.name: FVDT
inputParameters.description: Valid-from date of the agreement line whose staggered prices are listed.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which staggered prices on the agreement are listed.

inputParameters.name: OBV2
inputParameters.description: Second start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line to list when used.

inputParameters.name: OBV3
inputParameters.description: Third start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line to list when used.

inputParameters.name: OBV4
inputParameters.description: Fourth start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line to list when used.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number identifying the supplier whose staggered prices are listed.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number identifying the purchase agreement whose staggered prices are listed.

outputParameters.name: GRPI
outputParameters.description: Group identity that defines the key combination used to locate the agreement line whose staggered prices are listed.

outputParameters.name: OBV1
outputParameters.description: Primary start value in the group identity that, together with the group identity, identifies the agreement line whose staggered prices are listed.

outputParameters.name: OBV2
outputParameters.description: Second start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line to list when used.

outputParameters.name: OBV3
outputParameters.description: Third start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line to list when used.

outputParameters.name: OBV4
outputParameters.description: Fourth start value in the group identity that further specifies the agreement line to list when used.

outputParameters.name: FVDT
outputParameters.description: Valid-from date of the agreement line whose staggered prices are listed.

outputParameters.name: FRQT
outputParameters.description: Minimum quantity from which this staggered price applies, up to the next defined quantity break.

outputParameters.name: PUPR
outputParameters.description: Purchase price that applies at this quantity break on the agreement line.

outputParameters.name: DIP3
outputParameters.description: Third discount applied when calculating the net purchase price for this staggered price line.

outputParameters.name: MAPR
outputParameters.description: Normal reference purchase price for the item used for comparison against this staggered price.
